# Ruiz Family Enterprises Inc

> Family-led general engineering contractor based in Kingsburg, California, with concrete and masonry specialties for industrial, commercial, residential and custom projects across the Central Valley.

Official website: https://ruizfamilyhardscapes.biz/

The Ruiz family brings three generations of trade experience. Service areas are Kingsburg, Fresno, Madera, Visalia, Fowler and Hanford, California. Services are provided at customer properties; there is no public walk-in location.

Concrete services include patios, porches, pool decks, driveways, sidewalks, steps, stamped concrete, drain and gutter work, concrete removal and 3/8-inch concrete pump service. Masonry services include block walls, retaining walls, decorative stone, architectural stone and brick work.

For a free on-site estimate, call (559) 244-1922 or email ruizfamilyent@gmail.com. Share your project address, scope, approximate dimensions and any photos or plans. Contact the company directly to discuss availability and scheduling.
